# onyx-zk known-answer test vectors

Authoritative outputs from the vendored primitives, to be frozen into the C++ `--zk` test (Onyx O0
deliverable D4) so the C++ side asserts byte-for-byte agreement with the Rust reference. Generated by
`cargo test --release -- --nocapture` and confirmed reproduced from C++ via the smoke test
(`g++ ... -lonyx_zk`).

| Function | Input | Output (hex, little-endian field repr) |
|----------|-------|----------------------------------------|
| `onyx_poseidon_hash2` | two field elements, each = 32 bytes of `0x07` | `254e33e5ae446f78a45786a91a014e3da7d5423c5c6e38cc748ed0c98fde7f14` |
| `onyx_sinsemilla_hash` | ASCII `"onyx"` (domain `z.cash:Onyx-test-v6`) | `19b2738d4ee7132b21a2bed59918192ce7681e1da34d2a695fdfa47fed874e18` |
| `onyx_toy_prove`/`onyx_toy_verify` | a=6, b=7 (public = 42) | valid proof verifies (1); any tampered public input fails (0) |

These are pipeline-validation vectors, not protocol commitments. Real note-commitment and nullifier
vectors are produced in O1 once those circuits exist.
